title: Signal Tower
imageAlt: Signal Tower rising over dark forest and mountains
summary: A midgame location that turns the no-service problem into a direct Omni clue.
intro: The Signal Tower is a midgame objective where the Player expects outside contact and instead receives evidence that the silence is controlled.

details.label: Story role
details.value: Confirms Omni as an active influence

facts: The Signal Tower does not restore normal service.
It reveals corrupted broadcasts, copied voices, and hospital fragments.
Greg is already tied to the broadcast loop before the Player reaches the tower room.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: The Signal Tower is reached after The Camp is established and the Player has reason to investigate signal failure.
Greg waits at the perimeter and follows maintenance procedure for equipment that no longer works normally. He grants access to the upper route only after the Player follows his instructions.
The Player repairs, climbs, or activates the tower expecting emergency contact. Instead, the tower receives local transmissions that cannot exist normally.
This location changes the mystery from passive emptiness to active interference.
items: Primary question: is the outside world unreachable or blocked?
Key evidence: voices repeated from The Camp or Hospital.
Character effect: Greg proves the broadcast loop is tied to people; Amy becomes more important; Ali becomes more evasive.
